title: Make your KPIs look sharp and dazzling in Business Central (Advanced Spreadsheets and Reporting)

chapters.title: KPI card formatting and auto type

features.name: KPI card
features.description: A visual formatting feature for displaying key performance indicators in spreadsheets with various display options including values, comparisons, trends, targets, and status indicators.

features.name: KPI card auto type
features.description: A card type setting that automatically formats KPI cards based on defined settings to optimize presentation.

features.name: KPI compare value
features.description: A feature allowing comparison of a main value against another value to show relative performance, with indication of whether performance is above or below the comparison target.

features.name: KPI target bar visualization
features.description: A visual representation showing a target value as a bar or donut chart, displaying progress toward the target as a percentage.
caveats: can be displayed as bar or donut chart

features.name: KPI trend display
features.description: A feature for showing trend data in KPI cards as a visual representation of movement over time, without displaying a full chart.
caveats: displays movement but not as a full chart with numbers

features.name: KPI status with warning levels
features.description: A status indicator feature that shows KPI status based on warning and critical thresholds, alerting users when values fall below specified limits.
caveats: warning and critical levels can be combined
